name: Climate Change: Immediate and Urgent Problem
description: Percentage of adults who agree that 'climate change is an immediate and urgent problem'. Question first included in SHS in 2013. Note: 2020 and 2021 data collected by telephone due to COVID-19 and published as experimental statistics — not directly comparable to face-to-face years.

name: Weekly Visits to the Outdoors
description: Percentage of adults visiting the outdoors for recreation at least once a week. The large increase between 2019 and 2022 may partly reflect changed behaviour following the COVID-19 pandemic. No comparable data for 2020–2021 (telephone survey).

name: Walking Distance to Nearest Green or Blue Space
description: Percentage of adults who reported living within a 5-minute walk of their nearest green or blue space. The trend has been broadly flat across the time series, consistently lying between 65% and 70%.

name: Frequent Use of Nearest Green or Blue Space
description: Percentage of adults using their nearest green or blue space every day or several times a week. The proportion did not change between 2013 and 2019, then increased — possibly reflecting changed behaviour following COVID-19. Not asked in 2018 or 2022.

series.name: Every day / several times a week

name: Satisfaction with Nearest Green or Blue Space (2023)
description: Satisfaction with nearest green or blue space, 2023. The overall satisfaction level (76% very or fairly satisfied) has remained at a similar level throughout the time series. Not asked in 2018 or 2022.

questions.text: How satisfied are you with your nearest green or blue space?

name: Outdoor Visits by Self-Reported Health (2023)
description: Percentage of adults visiting the outdoors at least once a week, broken down by self-reported health status (2023). Adults in good or very good health are far more likely to visit the outdoors weekly.

questions.text: Weekly outdoor visits by self-reported health status
